<document index="3">
<source>README.md</source>
<document_content>
# Markdown Rundown

**Markdown Rundown** is a comprehensive summary of Markdown formatting styles, a live demonstration and testbed for various Python Markdown extensions, and a showcase of the [MkDocs](http://www.mkdocs.org/) static site generator.

This project is curated by [Adam Twardoch](http://github.com/twardoch).

## What is "Markdown Rundown"?

This project serves multiple purposes:

*   **A Reference Guide:** It provides a detailed overview of common Markdown syntax and, more importantly, a deep dive into numerous [Python Markdown](https://pythonhosted.org/Markdown/) extensions.
*   **A Testbed:** It acts as a practical environment for experimenting with and understanding how different Markdown extensions behave and integrate.
*   **An MkDocs Showcase:** The project itself is an MkDocs site, demonstrating how to structure, configure, and build a documentation website using Markdown. The live site can be viewed at [https://twardoch.github.io/markdown-rundown/](https://twardoch.github.io/markdown-rundown/).

## Who is it for?

This project is valuable for:

*   **Developers:** Who need to write documentation in Markdown and want to leverage advanced formatting options through extensions.
*   **Technical Writers:** Looking for a robust platform for creating and maintaining documentation.
*   **Markdown Users:** Anyone who wants to explore the capabilities of Markdown beyond its basic syntax.
*   **MkDocs Users:** Those who want to see a real-world example of an MkDocs setup with numerous extensions.

## Why is it useful?

*   **Centralized Information:** Consolidates information about many Python Markdown extensions in one place.
*   **Practical Examples:** Shows input Markdown and output HTML for many extensions, making it easy to understand their effects.
*   **Working Configuration:** Provides a complete, working MkDocs setup (`mkdocs.yml`, `pymdown.yml`) that can be used as a template.
*   **Live Demo:** The [hosted MkDocs site](https://twardoch.github.io/markdown-rundown/) allows users to see the rendered output immediately.

## Getting Started

### Viewing the Documentation

The easiest way to use Markdown Rundown is to browse the live site:
[https://twardoch.github.io/markdown-rundown/](https://twardoch.github.io/markdown-rundown/)

### Local Setup

To explore the code, experiment with extensions, or build the site locally:

1.  **Clone the repository:**
    ```bash
    git clone https://github.com/twardoch/markdown-rundown.git
    cd markdown-rundown
    ```

2.  **Install dependencies:**
    The project uses Python and several packages listed in `py-requirements.txt`. It's recommended to use a virtual environment.
    ```bash
    python -m venv venv
    source venv/bin/activate  # On Windows: venv\Scripts\activate
    pip install -r py-requirements.txt
    ```
    This will install MkDocs, Python Markdown, and all the extensions showcased.

3.  **Build the MkDocs site:**
    You can build the site using the provided script:
    ```bash
    ./tools/build-mkdocs.command
    ```
    Alternatively, if you have MkDocs installed and in your PATH, you can use standard MkDocs commands:
    ```bash
    mkdocs build
    ```
    The static site will be generated in the `docs/` directory. To serve the site locally for development:
    ```bash
    mkdocs serve
    ```
    This will start a local web server (usually at `http://127.0.0.1:8000/`).

### Using Extensions Programmatically

The `src/Extensions.md` file (and its rendered version on the site) provides examples of how to use many of the showcased Python Markdown extensions programmatically within your own Python projects. Typically, this involves:

```python
import markdown

markdown_string = "Your **Markdown** text here."
extensions_list = [
    'extension_name',
    # ... other extensions
]
extension_configs_dict = {
    'extension_name': {
        'param1': 'value1',
    }
}

html = markdown.markdown(
    markdown_string,
    extensions=extensions_list,
    extension_configs=extension_configs_dict
)

print(html)
```
Refer to `src/Extensions.md` for specific extension names and configuration options.

## Technical Details

### Project Structure

*   `.gitignore`: Specifies intentionally untracked files that Git should ignore.
*   `LICENSE`: The license for the project.
*   `README.md`: This file.
*   `docs/`: Contains the generated static HTML site built by MkDocs. **Do not edit files here directly.**
*   `extensions.md`: A top-level file, seems to be a placeholder or older content. The primary extension documentation is in `src/Extensions.md`.
*   `mkdocs.yml`: The main configuration file for MkDocs. It defines:
    *   Site metadata (name, author, URL).
    *   Navigation structure (`pages`).
    *   Theme (Material for MkDocs).
    *   A comprehensive list of Markdown extensions to be used and their specific configurations.
*   `py-requirements.txt`: Lists Python package dependencies.
*   `pymdown.yml`: Configuration file specifically for Pymdown Extensions. While `mkdocs.yml` also configures extensions, this file provides a way to manage Pymdown-specific settings. It's important to see how these two files interact; typically, `mkdocs.yml` settings might take precedence when MkDocs processes the files.
*   `src/`: Contains the raw Markdown source files for the documentation website.
    *   `src/index.md`: The homepage content.
    *   `src/Extensions.md`: The detailed documentation for various Python Markdown extensions. This is the core content of the "rundown." It includes installation instructions, usage examples (Python and CLI), options, and input/output samples for each extension.
    *   `src/Home.md`: Appears to be an older or auxiliary content page.
*   `tools/`: Contains helper scripts.
    *   `build-mkdocs.command`: A script to build the MkDocs site.
    *   `build-pymdown.command`: A script likely intended for testing or building with Pymdown-CLI directly (though MkDocs handles extension processing for the site).
    *   `install-macos.command`: Likely a script for macOS-specific setup or tool installation.
    *   `fix_subl.command`: Purpose unclear without further inspection, possibly a local utility for the author.

### Markdown Extensions Rundown (`src/Extensions.md`)

The heart of this project is the extensive documentation of Python Markdown extensions found in `src/Extensions.md`. This file (rendered as a page on the MkDocs site) covers a wide array of extensions, including:

*   Standard extensions (Tables, Footnotes, Admonition, etc.)
*   Pymdown Extensions (BetterEm, MagicLink, Mark, SuperFences, etc.)
*   Other third-party extensions (PyEmbed, Markdown Include, Sections, Outline, Cite, Collapse, Figcaption, FontAwesome, custom KBD/Wikilink steroids, and many more).

For each extension, it typically provides:
*   Installation instructions (`pip install ...`)
*   Links to official documentation
*   Configuration options (often in YAML format for `mkdocs.yml` or `pymdown.yml`)
*   Example Markdown input
*   Corresponding HTML output

This makes it an invaluable resource for understanding what extensions are available and how to use them.

### Coding and Contribution

This project is primarily a documentation and example site.

**Coding Style:**
*   **Markdown:** Follow standard Markdown best practices. Observe the formatting used in existing `src/` files for consistency.
*   **YAML:** `mkdocs.yml` and `pymdown.yml` should be well-formed YAML.
*   **Python (for extension examples):** Follow standard Python coding conventions (PEP 8).

**Contributing:**
While there isn't a formal `CONTRIBUTING.md`, general open-source contribution practices apply:
1.  **Fork the repository.**
2.  **Create a new branch** for your changes (e.g., `feature/add-new-extension` or `fix/typo-in-tables-doc`).
3.  **Make your changes.**
    *   If adding or updating information about a Markdown extension, edit `src/Extensions.md`. Ensure you provide clear examples, input, and output.
    *   If modifying site configuration, update `mkdocs.yml` or `pymdown.yml` as needed.
4.  **Test your changes locally** by building and serving the MkDocs site (`mkdocs serve`) to ensure everything renders correctly.
5.  **Commit your changes** with clear and descriptive messages.
6.  **Push your branch** to your fork.
7.  **Submit a pull request** to the main repository.

Please ensure that any additions or modifications are well-documented and align with the project's goal of providing a clear and useful rundown of Markdown capabilities.

## Author's Other Projects

Here are other projects related to Markdown and MkDocs by Adam Twardoch:

*   [https://twardoch.github.io/markdown-steroids/](https://twardoch.github.io/markdown-steroids/) — Some extensions for Python Markdown [git](https://github.com/twardoch/markdown-steroids)
*   [https://twardoch.github.io/markdown-utils/](https://twardoch.github.io/markdown-utils/) — various utilities for working with Markdown-based documents [git](https://github.com/twardoch/markdown-utils)
*   [https://twardoch.github.io/mkdocs-combine/](https://twardoch.github.io/mkdocs-combine/) — convert an MkDocs Markdown source site to a single Markdown document [git](https://github.com/twardoch/mkdocs-combine)
*   [https://github.com/twardoch/noto-mkdocs-theme/tree/rework](https://github.com/twardoch/noto-mkdocs-theme/tree/rework) — great Material Design-inspired theme for MkDocs [git](https://github.com/twardoch/noto-mkdocs-theme)
*   [https://twardoch.github.io/clinker-mktheme/](https://twardoch.github.io/clinker-mktheme/) — great theme for MkDocs [git](https://github.com/twardoch/clinker-mktheme)

---

This README aims to be a comprehensive guide. For the most detailed and interactive experience, please visit the [live MkDocs site](https://twardoch.github.io/markdown-rundown/).

<div class="section" id="extensions-install"><h2 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#extensions-install" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>This is a collected list of packages to install: </p>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>pip install --user --upgrade PyYAML
pip install --user --upgrade Markdown
pip install --user --upgrade pymdown-extensions
pip install --user --upgrade python-markdown-pretty
pip install --user --upgrade pyembed-markdown
pip install --user --upgrade markdown-include
pip install --user --upgrade mdx_sections
pip install --user --upgrade git+https://github.com/twardoch/markdown-steroids.git/@master#egg<span class="o">=</span>mdx_steroids-0.4.0
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="extensions-usage"><h2 class="title">Usage<a class="headerlink" href="#extensions-usage" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<div class="section" id="extensions-usage-python"><h3 class="title">Python<a class="headerlink" href="#extensions-usage-python" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="n">md</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">markdown</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Markdown</span><span class="p">(</span>
  <span class="n">extensions</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span>
  <span class="s1">&#39;markdown_include.include&#39;</span><span class="p">,</span>  <span class="s1">&#39;markdown_include.include&#39;</span><span class="p">,</span>

  <span class="s1">&#39;path/to/my_ext.py&#39;</span><span class="p">,</span>
  <span class="p">],</span>
  <span class="n">extension_configs</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="s1">&#39;markdown_include.include&#39;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{</span>
  <span class="n">base_path</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s1">&#39;./srcdocs&#39;</span>
  <span class="p">}</span>
  <span class="p">}</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">html</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">md</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">convert</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">markdown_string</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="extensions-usage-commandline"><h3 class="title">Command-line<a class="headerlink" href="#extensions-usage-commandline" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ol>
<li>Create a <code>config.yml</code> file that describes the <code>extension_configs</code> dictionary using YAML:</li>
</ol>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">markdown_include.include</span><span class="p p-Indicator">:</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">base_path</span><span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;./srcdocs&#39;</span>
</pre></div>


<ol>
<li>Run:</li>
</ol>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>$ python -m markdown <span class="se">\</span>
    -x path/to/my_ext.py <span class="se">\</span>
    -x markdown_include.include <span class="se">\</span>
    -c config.yml <span class="se">\</span>
    -o <span class="s1">&#39;html5&#39;</span> -f output.html input.md
</pre></div>


</div></div><div class="section" id="tables"><h2 class="title">tables<a class="headerlink" href="#tables" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>tables</code> extension adds the ability to create tables in Markdown documents.</p>
<div class="section" id="tables-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#tables-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<p><em>preinstalled</em></p>
</div><div class="section" id="tables-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#tables-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/tables.html">pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/tables.html</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="tables-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#tables-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<hr />
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>First Header</th>
<th>Second Header</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>Content Cell</td>
<td>Content Cell</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>Content Cell</td>
<td>Content Cell</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr />
<div class="section" id="tables-example-md"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#tables-example-md" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>First Header  | Second Header
------------- | -------------
Content Cell  | Content Cell
Content Cell  | Content Cell
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="tables-example-html"><h4 class="title">Output HTML<a class="headerlink" href="#tables-example-html" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">table</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
  <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">thead</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">tr</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
      <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">th</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>First Header<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">th</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
      <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">th</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Second Header<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">th</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">tr</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
  <span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">thead</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
  <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">tbody</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">tr</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
      <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">td</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Content Cell<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">td</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
      <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">td</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Content Cell<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">td</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">tr</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">tr</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
      <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">td</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Content Cell<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">td</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
      <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">td</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Content Cell<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">td</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">tr</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
  <span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">tbody</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">table</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
</pre></div>


</div></div></div><div class="section" id="abbr"><h2 class="title">abbr<a class="headerlink" href="#abbr" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>abbr</code> extension adds the ability to define abbreviations, which are then wrapped in an <code>&lt;abbr&gt;</code> tag.</p>
<div class="section" id="abbr-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#abbr-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<p><em>preinstalled</em></p>
</div><div class="section" id="abbr-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#abbr-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/abbreviations.html">pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/abbreviations.html</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="abbr-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#abbr-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<hr />
<p>The <abbr title="Web Open Font Format">WOFF</abbr> specification is maintained by the <abbr title="World Wide Web Consortium">W3C</abbr>.</p>
<hr />
<div class="section" id="abbr-example-md"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#abbr-example-md" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>The WOFF specification is maintained by the W3C.

*[WOFF]: Web Open Font Format
*[W3C]:  World Wide Web Consortium
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="abbr-example-html"><h4 class="title">Output HTML<a class="headerlink" href="#abbr-example-html" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>The <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">abbr</span> <span class="na">title</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;Hyper Text Markup Language&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>HTML<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">abbr</span><span class="p">&gt;</span> specification
is maintained by the <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">abbr</span> <span class="na">title</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;World Wide Web Consortium&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>W3C<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">abbr</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>.<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
</pre></div>


</div></div></div><div class="section" id="attr_list"><h2 class="title">attr_list<a class="headerlink" href="#attr_list" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>attr_list</code> extension adds a syntax to define attributes on the various HTML elements in markdown’s output.</p>
<div class="section" id="attr_list-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#attr_list-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<p><em>preinstalled</em></p>
</div><div class="section" id="attr_list-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#attr_list-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/attr_list.html">pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/attr_list.html</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="attr_list-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#attr_list-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<hr />
</div><div class="section" id="header_3"><h3 class="title">Header 3<a class="headerlink" href="#header_3" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<p><a class="foo bar" href="http://example.com" title="Some title!">link</a></p>
<p class="class_1 class_2" id="an_id" title="explain">This is a paragraph.<br /></p>
<hr />
<div class="section" id="attr_list-example-md"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#attr_list-example-md" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="k">### </span><span class="gh">Header 3 {: #header_3 }</span>

[link](http://example.com){: class=&quot;foo bar&quot; title=&quot;Some title!&quot; }

This is a paragraph.
{: #an<span class="k">_</span><span class="ge">id .class</span><span class="k">_</span>1 .class_2 title=&quot;explain&quot; }
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="attr_list-example-html"><h4 class="title">Output HTML<a class="headerlink" href="#attr_list-example-html" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">h3</span> <span class="na">id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;header_3&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Header 3<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">h3</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
<span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;&lt;</span><span class="nt">a</span> <span class="na">href</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;http://example.com&quot;</span> <span class="na">class</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;foo bar&quot;</span> <span class="na">title</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;Some title!&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>link<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">a</span><span class="p">&gt;&lt;/</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
<span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">p</span> <span class="na">id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;an_id&quot;</span> <span class="na">class</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;class_1 class_2&quot;</span> <span class="na">title</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;explain&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>This is a paragraph.<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
</pre></div>


</div></div></div><div class="section" id="markdown_attr_plus"><h2 class="title">markdown_attr_plus<a class="headerlink" href="#markdown_attr_plus" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>markdown_attr_plus</code> extension modifies the default Attribute List extension to include <code>{^ ... }</code>, <code>{o ... }</code>, and <code>{&gt; ... }</code> syntax, which specifically only modify lists, list items, and blockquotes respectively.</p>
<div class="section" id="markdown_attr_plus-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#markdown_attr_plus-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>pip install --user --upgrade markdown-attr-plus
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="markdown_attr_plus-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#markdown_attr_plus-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Code</strong>: <a href="https://github.com/Undeterminant/markdown-attr-plus">github.com/Undeterminant/markdown-attr-plus</a></li>
</ul>
</div></div><div class="section" id="admonition"><h2 class="title">admonition<a class="headerlink" href="#admonition" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>admonition</code> extension adds rST-style admonitions to Markdown documents.</p>
<div class="section" id="admonition-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#admonition-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<p><em>preinstalled</em></p>
</div><div class="section" id="admonition-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#admonition-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/admonition.html">pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/admonition.html</a></li>
</ul>
<p>Common admonition types are: <code>attention</code>, <code>caution</code>, <code>danger</code>, <code>error</code>, <code>hint</code>, <code>important</code>, <code>note</code>, <code>tip</code>, <code>warning</code></p>
</div><div class="section" id="admonition-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#admonition-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<hr />
<div class="admonition important">
<p class="admonition-title">Word of warning</p>
</div>
<p>This is a admonition box.</p>
<hr />
<div class="section" id="admonition-example-md"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#admonition-example-md" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>!!! important &quot;Word of warning&quot;
This is a admonition box.
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="admonition-example-html"><h4 class="title">Output HTML<a class="headerlink" href="#admonition-example-html" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">div</span> <span class="na">class</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;admonition important&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">p</span> <span class="na">class</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;admonition-title&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Word of warning<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>This is a admonition box.<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">div</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
</pre></div>


</div></div></div><div class="section" id="codehilite"><h2 class="title">codehilite<a class="headerlink" href="#codehilite" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>codehilite</code> extension adds code/syntax highlighting to standard Python-Markdown code blocks using <a href="http://pygments.org/">Pygments</a>.</p>
<div class="section" id="codehilite-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#codehilite-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<p><em>preinstalled</em></p>
</div><div class="section" id="codehilite-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#codehilite-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/code_hilite.html">pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/code_hilite.html</a></li>
<li><a href="http://pygments.org/docs/">pygments.org/docs/</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="codehilite-options"><h3 class="title">Options<a class="headerlink" href="#codehilite-options" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>  <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">codehilite</span><span class="p p-Indicator">:</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">css_class</span>      <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;code&#39;</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">linenums</span>       <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">null</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">guess_lang</span>     <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">true</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">use_pygments</span>   <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">true</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">pygments_style</span> <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;default&#39;</span>  
</pre></div>


</div></div><div class="section" id="def_list"><h2 class="title">def_list<a class="headerlink" href="#def_list" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>def_list</code> extension adds the ability to create definition lists in Markdown documents.</p>
<div class="section" id="def_list-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#def_list-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<p><em>preinstalled</em></p>
</div><div class="section" id="def_list-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#def_list-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/definition_lists.html">pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/definition_lists.html</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="def_list-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#def_list-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<hr />
<dl>
<dt>Apple</dt>
<dd>Pomaceous fruit of plants of the genus Malus in<br />
the family Rosaceae.</dd>
<dt>Orange</dt>
<dd>The fruit of an evergreen tree of the genus Citrus.</dd>
</dl>
<hr />
<div class="section" id="def_list-example-md"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#def_list-example-md" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>Apple
:   Pomaceous fruit of plants of the genus Malus in
    the family Rosaceae.

Orange
:   The fruit of an evergreen tree of the genus Citrus.
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="def_list-example-html"><h4 class="title">Output HTML<a class="headerlink" href="#def_list-example-html" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">dl</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">dt</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Apple<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">dt</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">dd</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Pomaceous fruit of plants of the genus Malus in the family Rosaceae.<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">dd</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">dt</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Orange<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">dt</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">dd</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>The fruit of an evergreen tree of the genus Citrus.<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">dd</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">dl</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
</pre></div>


</div></div></div><div class="section" id="footnotes"><h2 class="title">footnotes<a class="headerlink" href="#footnotes" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>footnotes</code> extension adds syntax for defining footnotes in Markdown documents.</p>
<div class="section" id="footnotes-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#footnotes-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<p><em>preinstalled</em></p>
</div><div class="section" id="footnotes-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#footnotes-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/footnotes.html">pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/footnotes.html</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="footnotes-options"><h3 class="title">Options<a class="headerlink" href="#footnotes-options" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>  <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">footnotes</span><span class="p p-Indicator">:</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">PLACE_MARKER</span>   <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;///Footnotes</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">Go</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">Here///&#39;</span> 
    <span class="c1"># if the place marker text is not found in the document, </span>
    <span class="c1"># the footnote definitions are placed at the end of the resulting HTML document</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">UNIQUE_IDS</span>     <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">false</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">BACKLINK_TEXT</span>  <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;&amp;#8617;&#39;</span>  
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="footnotes-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#footnotes-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<hr />
<p>Footnotes<sup id="fnref:1"><a class="footnote-ref" href="#fn:1" rel="footnote">1</a></sup> have a label<sup id="fnref:@#$%"><a class="footnote-ref" href="#fn:@#$%" rel="footnote">2</a></sup> and the footnote’s content.</p>
<div class="footnote">
<hr />
<ol>
<li id="fn:1">
<p>This is a footnote content.&#160;<a class="footnote-backref" href="#fnref:1" rev="footnote" title="Jump back to footnote 1 in the text">&#8617;</a></p>
</li>
<li id="fn:@#$%">
<p>A footnote on the label: “@#$%”.&#160;<a class="footnote-backref" href="#fnref:@#$%" rev="footnote" title="Jump back to footnote 2 in the text">&#8617;</a></p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<hr />
<div class="section" id="footnotes-example-md"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#footnotes-example-md" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>Footnotes[^1] have a label[^@#$%] and the footnote&#39;s content.

[^1]: This is a footnote content.
[^@#$%]: A footnote on the label: &quot;@#$%&quot;.

///Footnotes Go Here///
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="footnotes-example-html"><h4 class="title">Output HTML<a class="headerlink" href="#footnotes-example-html" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Footnotes<span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">a</span> <span class="na">href</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;#fn:1&quot;</span> <span class="na">id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;fnref:1&quot;</span> <span class="na">title</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;see footnote&quot;</span> <span class="na">class</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;footnote&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>[1]<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">a</span><span class="p">&gt;</span> have a label<span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">a</span> <span class="na">href</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;#fn:2&quot;</span> <span class="na">id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;fnref:2&quot;</span> <span class="na">title</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;see footnote&quot;</span> <span class="na">class</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;footnote&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>[2]<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">a</span><span class="p">&gt;</span> and the footnote’s content.<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>

<span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">div</span> <span class="na">class</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;footnotes&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">hr</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">ol</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
        <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">li</span> <span class="na">id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;fn:1&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
            <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>This is a footnote content. <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">a</span> <span class="na">href</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;#fnref:1&quot;</span> <span class="na">title</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;return to article&quot;</span> <span class="na">class</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;reversefootnote&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span><span class="ni">&amp;nbsp;</span>↩<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">a</span><span class="p">&gt;&lt;/</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
        <span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">li</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
        <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">li</span> <span class="na">id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;fn:2&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
            <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>A footnote on the label: “@#$%”. <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">a</span> <span class="na">href</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;#fnref:2&quot;</span> <span class="na">title</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;return to article&quot;</span> <span class="na">class</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;reversefootnote&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span><span class="ni">&amp;nbsp;</span>↩<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">a</span><span class="p">&gt;&lt;/</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
        <span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">li</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">ol</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">div</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
</pre></div>


</div></div></div><div class="section" id="meta"><h2 class="title">meta<a class="headerlink" href="#meta" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>meta</code> extension adds a syntax for defining meta-data about a document.</p>
<div class="section" id="meta-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#meta-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<p><em>preinstalled</em></p>
</div><div class="section" id="meta-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#meta-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/meta_data.html">pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/meta_data.html</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="meta-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#meta-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="section" id="meta-example-input"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#meta-example-input" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>Title:   My Document
Summary: A brief description of my document.
Authors: Waylan Limberg
         John Doe
Date:    October 2, 2007
blank-value:
base_url: http://example.com

This is the first paragraph of the document.
</pre></div>


</div></div></div><div class="section" id="nl2br"><h2 class="title">nl2br<a class="headerlink" href="#nl2br" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>nl2br</code> extension will cause newlines to be treated as hard breaks.</p>
<div class="section" id="nl2br-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#nl2br-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<p><em>preinstalled</em></p>
</div><div class="section" id="nl2br-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#nl2br-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/nl2br.html">pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/nl2br.html</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="nl2br-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#nl2br-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<hr />
<p>Line 1<br />
Line 2</p>
<hr />
<div class="section" id="nl2br-example-md"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#nl2br-example-md" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>Line 1
Line 2
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="nl2br-example-html"><h4 class="title">Output HTML<a class="headerlink" href="#nl2br-example-html" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Line 1<span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">br</span> <span class="p">/&gt;</span>
Line 2<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
</pre></div>


</div></div></div><div class="section" id="smarty"><h2 class="title">smarty<a class="headerlink" href="#smarty" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>smarty</code> extension converts ASCII dashes, quotes and ellipses to their HTML entity equivalents.</p>
<div class="section" id="smarty-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#smarty-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<p><em>preinstalled</em></p>
</div><div class="section" id="smarty-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#smarty-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/smarty.html">pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/smarty.html</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="smarty-options"><h3 class="title">Options<a class="headerlink" href="#smarty-options" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>  <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">smarty</span><span class="p p-Indicator">:</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">smart_dashes</span>           <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">true</span>  <span class="c1"># convert dashes</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">smart_quotes</span>           <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">true</span>  <span class="c1"># convert straight quotes</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">smart_angled_quotes</span>    <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">false</span> <span class="c1"># whether to convert angled quotes</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">smart_ellipses</span>         <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">true</span>  <span class="c1"># whether to convert ellipses</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">substitutions</span><span class="p p-Indicator">:</span>                 <span class="c1"># overwrite default substitutions</span>
        <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">left-single-quote</span>  <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;‘&#39;</span>   <span class="c1"># &#39;</span>
        <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">right-single-quote</span> <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;’&#39;</span>   <span class="c1"># &#39;</span>
        <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">left-double-quote</span>  <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;“&#39;</span>   <span class="c1"># &quot;</span>
        <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">right-double-quote</span> <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;”&#39;</span>   <span class="c1"># &quot;</span>
        <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">left-angle-quote</span>   <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;«&#39;</span>   <span class="c1"># &lt;&lt;</span>
        <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">right-angle-quote</span>  <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;»&#39;</span>   <span class="c1"># &gt;&gt;</span>
        <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">ellipsis</span>           <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;…&#39;</span>   <span class="c1"># ...</span>
        <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">ndash</span>              <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;–&#39;</span>   <span class="c1"># --</span>
        <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">mdash</span>              <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;—&#39;</span>   <span class="c1"># ---</span>
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="smarty-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#smarty-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<hr />
<p>The “quick brown” fox’s tail — voila…</p>
<hr />
<div class="section" id="smarty-example-md"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#smarty-example-md" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>The &quot;quick brown&quot; fox&#39;s tail --- voila...
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="smarty-example-html"><h4 class="title">Output HTML<a class="headerlink" href="#smarty-example-html" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>The “quick brown” fox’s tail — voila…<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
</pre></div>


</div></div></div><div class="section" id="toc"><h2 class="title">toc<a class="headerlink" href="#toc" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>toc</code> extension</p>
<div class="section" id="toc-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#toc-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<p><em>preinstalled</em></p>
</div><div class="section" id="toc-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#toc-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/toc.html">pythonhosted.org/Markdown/extensions/toc.html</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="toc-options"><h3 class="title">Options<a class="headerlink" href="#toc-options" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>  <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">toc</span><span class="p p-Indicator">:</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">permalink</span>      <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;❡&#39;</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">marker</span>         <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;[TOC]&#39;</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">title</span>          <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;Table</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">of</span><span class="nv"> </span><span class="s">Contents&#39;</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">anchorlink</span>     <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">true</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">baselevel</span>      <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">1</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">separator</span>      <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;-&#39;</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">slugify</span>        <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">headerid.slugify</span>
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="toc-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#toc-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="section" id="toc-example-md"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#toc-example-md" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>[TOC]

<span class="k"># </span><span class="gh">Header 1</span>

<span class="k">## </span><span class="gh">Header 2 {: #Header 2 }</span>
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="toc-example-html"><h4 class="title">Output HTML<a class="headerlink" href="#toc-example-html" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">div</span> <span class="na">class</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;toc&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
  <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">ul</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">li</span><span class="p">&gt;&lt;</span><span class="nt">a</span> <span class="na">href</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;#header-1&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Header 1<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">a</span><span class="p">&gt;&lt;/</span><span class="nt">li</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
      <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">ul</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
        <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">li</span><span class="p">&gt;&lt;</span><span class="nt">a</span> <span class="na">href</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;#header-2&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Header 2<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">a</span><span class="p">&gt;&lt;/</span><span class="nt">li</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
      <span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">ul</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
  <span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">ul</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">div</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
<span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">h1</span> <span class="na">id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;header-1&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Header 1<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">h1</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
<span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">h1</span> <span class="na">id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;header-2&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Header 2<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">h1</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
</pre></div>


</div></div></div><div class="section" id="pymdownx.betterem"><h2 class="title">pymdownx.betterem<a class="headerlink" href="#pymdownx.betterem" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>pymdownx.betterem</code> extension improves emphasis (<strong>bold</strong> and <em>italic</em>) handling.</p>
<div class="section" id="pymdownx.betterem-installatio"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#pymdownx.betterem-installatio" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>pip install --user --upgrade pymdown-extensions
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="pymdownx.betterem-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#pymdownx.betterem-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="http://facelessuser.github.io/pymdown-extensions/extensions/betterem/">facelessuser.github.io/pymdown-extensions/extensions/betterem/</a></li>
<li>Replaces <code>smartstrong</code></li>
<li><strong>Code</strong>: <a href="https://github.com/facelessuser/pymdown-extensions/blob/master/pymdownx/betterem.py">github.com/facelessuser/pymdown-extensions/blob/master/pymdownx/betterem.py</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="pymdownx.betterem-options"><h3 class="title">Options<a class="headerlink" href="#pymdownx.betterem-options" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>  <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">pymdownx.betterem</span><span class="p p-Indicator">:</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">smart_enable</span>   <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;all&#39;</span>                <span class="c1"># &#39;all&#39; | &#39;asterisk&#39; | &#39;underscore&#39; | &#39;none&#39;</span>
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="pymdownx.betterem-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#pymdownx.betterem-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<hr />
<p>Usage is the <strong>same</strong> as usual. Just keep in mind the <em>differences</em>. </p>
<hr />
<div class="section" id="pymdownx.betterem-example-md"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#pymdownx.betterem-example-md" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>Usage is the <span class="k">__</span><span class="gs">same</span><span class="k">__</span> as usual. Just keep in mind the <span class="k">_</span><span class="ge">differences</span><span class="k">_</span>. 
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="pymdownx.betterem-example-html"><h4 class="title">Output HTML<a class="headerlink" href="#pymdownx.betterem-example-html" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Usage is the <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">strong</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>same<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">strong</span><span class="p">&gt;</span> as usual. Just keep in mind the <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">em</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>differences<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">em</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>. <span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
</pre></div>

</div></div></div><div class="section" id="pymdownx.superfences"><h2 class="title">pymdownx.superfences<a class="headerlink" href="#pymdownx.superfences" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>pymdownx.superfences</code> extension adds flexible ways to define code blocks, and replaces the  <code>fenced_code</code> extension.</p>
<div class="section" id="pymdownx.superfences-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#pymdownx.superfences-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>pip install --user --upgrade pymdown-extensions
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="pymdownx.superfences-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#pymdownx.superfences-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://facelessuser.github.io/pymdown-extensions/extensions/superfences/">facelessuser.github.io/pymdown-extensions/extensions/superfences/</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="pymdownx.superfences-options"><h3 class="title">Options<a class="headerlink" href="#pymdownx.superfences-options" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>  <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">pymdownx.superfences</span><span class="p p-Indicator">:</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">disable_indented_code_blocks</span> <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">false</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">nested</span>         <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">true</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">uml_flow</span>       <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">false</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">uml_sequence</span>   <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">false</span>
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="pymdownx.superfences-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#pymdownx.superfences-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<hr />
<blockquote>
<p>```python<br />
class MyClass(object):<br />
  def <strong>init</strong>(self):<br />
    return pass</p>
<p>print(“Done”)<br />
```</p>
</blockquote>
<hr />
<div class="section" id="pymdownx.superfences-example-md"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#pymdownx.superfences-example-md" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>

<span class="sb">class MyClass(object):</span>
<span class="sb">  def __init__(self):</span>
<span class="sb">    return pass</span>

<span class="sb">&gt; print(&quot;Done&quot;)</span>
<span class="err">`</span><span class="k">``</span>
</pre></div>

</div></div></div><div class="section" id="pyembed.markdown"><h2 class="title">pyembed.markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#pyembed.markdown" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>pyembed.markdown</code> extension allows you to embed content in your Markdown websites and documents from a wide range of producers using OEmbed. </p>
<div class="section" id="pyembed.markdown-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#pyembed.markdown-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>pip install --user --upgrade pyembed-markdown
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="pyembed.markdown-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#pyembed.markdown-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://pyembed.github.io/usage/markdown/">pyembed.github.io/usage/markdown/</a></li>
<li><a href="https://pyembed.github.io/">pyembed.github.io/</a></li>
<li><strong>Code</strong>: <a href="https://github.com/pyembed/pyembed-markdown">github.com/pyembed/pyembed-markdown</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="pyembed.markdown-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#pyembed.markdown-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="section" id="pyembed.markdown-example-md"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#pyembed.markdown-example-md" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>[!embed](http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9bZkp7q19f0)
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="pyembed.markdown-example.html"><h4 class="title">Output HTML<a class="headerlink" href="#pyembed.markdown-example.html" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">iframe</span> <span class="na">width</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;480&quot;</span> <span class="na">height</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;270&quot;</span> <span class="na">src</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;http://www.youtube.com/embed/9bZkp7q19f0?feature=oembed&quot;</span> <span class="na">frameborder</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;0&quot;</span> <span class="na">allowfullscreen</span><span class="p">&gt;&lt;/</span><span class="nt">iframe</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
</pre></div>


</div></div></div><div class="section" id="markdown_include.include"><h2 class="title">markdown_include.include<a class="headerlink" href="#markdown_include.include" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>markdown_include.include</code> extension replaces the <code>Welcome to the markdown-rundown wiki!</code> statement with the contents of <code>Home.md</code>. It works recursively, prior to any other Markdown processing. </p>
<div class="section" id="markdown_include.include-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#markdown_include.include-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>pip install --user --upgrade markdown-include
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="markdown_include.include-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#markdown_include.include-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/cmacmackin/markdown-include">github.com/cmacmackin/markdown-include</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="markdown_include.include-options"><h3 class="title">Options<a class="headerlink" href="#markdown_include.include-options" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>  <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">markdown_include.include</span><span class="p p-Indicator">:</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">base_path</span>      <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;./srcdocs/&#39;</span>
    <span class="l l-Scalar l-Scalar-Plain">encoding</span>       <span class="p p-Indicator">:</span> <span class="s">&#39;utf-8&#39;</span>
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="markdown_include.include-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#markdown_include.include-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<hr />
<p>Welcome to the markdown-rundown wiki!</p>
<hr />
<div class="section" id="markdown_include.include-example-md"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#markdown_include.include-example-md" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<p><code><br />
Welcome to the markdown-rundown wiki!<br />
</code></p>
</div></div></div><div class="section" id="sections"><h2 class="title">sections<a class="headerlink" href="#sections" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>sections</code> extension adds a small amount of structure to Markdown documents.</p>
<div class="section" id="sections-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#sections-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>pip install --user --upgrade mdx_sections
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="sections-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#sections-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/jessedhillon/mdx_sections">github.com/jessedhillon/mdx_sections</a></li>
</ul>
</div></div><div class="section" id="outline"><h2 class="title">outline<a class="headerlink" href="#outline" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>outline</code> extension uses the <code>h1</code>-<code>h6</code> headings to create HTML <code>section</code> elements with the <code>sectionN</code> class, where <code>N</code> is the header level being wrapped. Also, the header attributes get moved to the wrapper.  </p>
<div class="section" id="outline-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#outline-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>pip install --user --upgrade mdx_outline
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="outline-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#outline-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/aleray/mdx_outline">github.com/aleray/mdx_outline</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="outline-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#outline-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="section" id="outline-example-md"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#outline-example-md" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="k"># </span><span class="gh">Introduction {: foo=bar }</span>

This is a paragraph. 
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="outline-example-html"><h4 class="title">Output HTML<a class="headerlink" href="#outline-example-html" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">section</span> <span class="na">class</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;section1&quot;</span> <span class="na">foo</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;bar&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">h1</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Introduction<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">h1</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>This is a paragraph.<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">section</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
</pre></div>


</div></div></div><div class="section" id="cite"><h2 class="title">cite<a class="headerlink" href="#cite" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>cite</code> extension wraps the inline content surrounded by three double quotes into <code>cite</code> tags. </p>
<div class="section" id="cite-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#cite-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>pip install --user --upgrade mdx_cite
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="cite-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#cite-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/aleray/mdx_cite">github.com/aleray/mdx_cite</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="cite-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#cite-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<hr />
<p><cite>In the Loop</cite> is the last movie I watched.</p>
<hr />
<div class="section" id="cite-example-md"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#cite-example-md" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>&quot;&quot;&quot;In the Loop&quot;&quot;&quot; is the last movie I watched.
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="cite-example-html"><h4 class="title">Output HTML<a class="headerlink" href="#cite-example-html" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;&lt;</span><span class="nt">cite</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>In the Loop<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">cite</span><span class="p">&gt;</span> is the last movie I watched.<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">p</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
</pre></div>


</div></div></div><div class="section" id="collapse"><h2 class="title">collapse<a class="headerlink" href="#collapse" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>collapse</code> extension defines collapsible areas. </p>
<div class="admonition warning">
<p class="admonition-title">The <code>collapse</code> extension makes problems</p>
</div>
<div class="section" id="collapse-installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#collapse-installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>pip install --user --upgrade mdx_collapse
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="collapse-docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#collapse-docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/AlexJF/mdx_collapse">github.com/AlexJF/mdx_collapse</a></li>
</ul>
</div><div class="section" id="collapse-example"><h3 class="title">Example<a class="headerlink" href="#collapse-example" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<hr />
<p>&lt;&lt;&lt; “Collapsible stuff”<br />
    * Stuff 1<br />
    * Stuff 2<br />
    * Stuff 3<br />
    * Stuff 4</p>
<hr />
<div class="section" id="collapse-example-md"><h4 class="title">Input Markdown<a class="headerlink" href="#collapse-example-md" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>&lt;&lt;&lt; &quot;Collapsible stuff&quot;
<span class="k">    * </span>Stuff 1
<span class="k">    * </span>Stuff 2
<span class="k">    * </span>Stuff 3
<span class="k">    * </span>Stuff 4
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="collapse-example-html"><h4 class="title">Output HTML<a class="headerlink" href="#collapse-example-html" title="Permanent link">»</a></h4>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">div</span> <span class="na">class</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;panel panel-default panel-collapsible&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">div</span> <span class="na">class</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;panel-heading&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
        <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">a</span> <span class="na">data-toggle</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;collapse&quot;</span> <span class="na">data-target</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;#collapse1&quot;</span> <span class="p">/&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">div</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">div</span> <span class="na">id</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;collapse1&quot;</span> <span class="na">class</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s">&quot;panel-body collapse in&quot;</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
        <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">ul</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
            <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">li</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Stuff 1<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">li</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
            <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">li</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Stuff 2<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">li</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
            <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">li</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Stuff 3<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">li</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
            <span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nt">li</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>Stuff 4<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">li</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
        <span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">ul</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
    <span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">div</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
<span class="p">&lt;/</span><span class="nt">div</span><span class="p">&gt;</span>
</pre></div>


</div></div></div><div class="section" id="custom_span_class"><h2 class="title">custom_span_class<a class="headerlink" href="#custom_span_class" title="Permanent link">»</a></h2>
<p>The <code>custom_span_class</code> allows adding span elements with custom class. </p>
<div class="section" id="installation"><h3 class="title">Installation<a class="headerlink" href="#installation" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
<div class="code"><pre><span></span>pip install --user --upgrade mdx_customspanclass
</pre></div>


</div><div class="section" id="docs"><h3 class="title">Docs<a class="headerlink" href="#docs" title="Permanent link">»</a></h3>
